WITH pair_averages AS (
    SELECT
        sf.transref,
        t.tradekind,
        AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
        ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t
        ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
),
pair_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        p.transref,
        p.tradekind,
        p.avg_optvolrt,
        ABS(p.avg_optvolrt - o.avg_optvolrt) AS deviation
    FROM pair_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE o.avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        transref,
        tradekind,
        avg_optvolrt,
        deviation,
        AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
    FROM pair_deviations
    WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
selected_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        tradekind,
        avg_optvolrt,
        deviation,
        deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess
    FROM ranked_pairs
    WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS average_option_volume_ratio,
    AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation,
    AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM selected_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind;
